# The two items of examples/merge-order, killed after the dependency sent its message and the waiting item received it, while both runs wait for the owner.
# A second beehave run continues each run. The dependency merged once and sent once, the waiting item received once, and no step ran again.
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

example merge-order/waiting.star
example merge-order/dependency.star
example merge-order/project.star config/projects/orders.star
env WAITER=ui-1
chmod 755 fake/merge-pr
subst fake/merge-pr

exec beehavereal item add orders ui-1 --title 'UI' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal item add orders base-1 --title 'Base' --body-file body.txt

! exec sh first.sh run ui-1 orders --workflow merge-order/waiting.star &
waitstatus 'waits for a message on topic landed'
! exec sh second.sh run base-1 orders --workflow merge-order/dependency.star &
waitstatus 'ui-1 is merged after base-1'
waitstatus 'The pull request of base-1 is merged'
kill -KILL
wait

cmp merge.log expected-before.log

# The run of ui-1 starts first and owns the engine. The run of base-1 joins it. When ui-1 ends first, the command of base-1 takes over the engine and finishes its run.
exec beehavereal run ui-1 orders --workflow merge-order/waiting.star &ui&
waitstatus 'ui-1 is merged after base-1'
exec beehavereal run base-1 orders --workflow merge-order/dependency.star &base&
waitstatus 'The pull request of base-1 is merged'
exec beehavereal answer ui-1 done
wait ui
exec beehavereal answer base-1 done
wait base

exec beehavereal status item-base-1-r1
stdout -count=1 '^send:tell#1\t'
! stdout '^send:tell#2'

exec beehavereal status item-ui-1-r1
stdout -count=1 '^recv:dependency#1\t'
! stdout '^recv:dependency#2'

cmp merge.log expected-after.log

-- first.sh --
exec beehavereal "$@" 2> first.err
-- second.sh --
exec beehavereal "$@" 2> second.err
-- body.txt --
Land in order.
-- fake/merge-pr --
#!/bin/sh
# The fake merge command: it logs the words it got.
echo "$*" >> "@WORK@/merge.log"
-- expected-before.log --
base-1
ui-1 after base-1
-- expected-after.log --
base-1
ui-1 after base-1
